about: Codex 0.162.1's screens under tmux 3.7c as `capture-pane -p` gives them, paths sanitized: each dialog of its own that the needs scan reads off its screen (capabilities.dialog_on_screen) with the words it reads, and screens that show none. The folder-trust, hook-review, Switch, Implement-this-plan, numbered-draft and after-Esc screens were measured for task #108 in a fleet window (160x40) with a loopback provider at 100 % of its window; the others are the measured screens tests/test_codex_fleet_parity.py, tests/test_remote_needs_codex.py and tests/test_remote_codex.py hold. A screen marked ready is one capabilities.ready_on_screen (or its default) reads as ready for a typed line; every other is not. capabilities.modal_on_screen (or its default) names each dialog by its words, and no screen without one. Codex 0.164.0's screens, measured in a fleet window the same way (folder trust, hook review, approval, question, Implement this plan?, Switch, the empty prompt, one and two Escs, drafts, a turn), read the same as these; only a refused command's line changed (`• Failed (exit 1)` became `• Exited (status 1)`), which nothing reads. Its update dialog is the one screen here measured on 0.164.0. The `Working directory · fork` screen is the chooser a bare `codex fork <id>` opened, run from a directory other than the source thread's last cwd (a hand-off Fork into its own worktree, SMOKE8 of #113), measured the same on 0.162.1 and 0.164.0 under tmux 3.8 (160x40, --no-alt-screen); with -C the fork opens none.
